description: Look up the FHFA conforming loan limit for a US county in calendar year 2026 — the maximum loan Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac will buy, for 1- to 4-unit properties. Covers all 3235 counties and county equivalents. Returns the baseline for counties with no special designation, and flags the 160 high-cost counties whose limit is above it. Pass a county name, a 5-digit FIPS code, or a state to list its counties.

county.description: County name, with or without 'County'/'Parish' and state, e.g. 'King County, WA' or 'king'.

fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS, e.g. '53033'. Takes precedence over county.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. 'WA'. Filters results; on its own, lists that state's counties.

name: search_conforming_limits

baseline_limit.description: The 1-unit limit that applies in counties with no special designation.

matched.description: How many counties matched the query, before truncation.

title: Search 2026 US conforming loan limits by county
